name: Government Polytechnic College, Alwar
affiliated_to: Board of Technical Education Rajasthan (BTER), Jodhpur & Approved by AICTE
overview: Government Polytechnic College, Alwar is located strategically near the Matsya Industrial Area (MIA), providing students with unmatched industry exposure, regular industrial visits, and hands-on apprenticeship opportunities across leading automotive and manufacturing giants in NCR.
admission_process: Admissions through DTE Rajasthan centralized online counseling based on 10th standard merit list. Registration starts typically in June-July each year on the SSO Rajasthan portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in). Lateral entry counseling is held separately.
eligibility: 10th Class passed with minimum 35% marks from recognized board with Science & Math. Lateral Entry requires 12th PCM or 2-year ITI trade certificate.

fee_structure.fee_exemptions: 100% tuition waiver for female students and SC/ST candidates as per Rajasthan DTE norms.

scholarships: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme by Social Justice Department Rajasthan.
Mukhyamantri Uchh Shiksha Chhatravriti (₹5,000 per year).
AICTE Pragati Scholarship for single girl child or girls in technical diploma (₹50,000/year).
BOCW Labor Department Child Education Assistance.
hostel_facilities: Separate Boys and Girls hostels available with 120-bed capacity for boys and 60-bed capacity for girls. Mess facility managed cooperatively, round-the-clock security guards, recreation room with TV, and Wi-Fi.
campus_facilities: Specialized Chemical testing laboratory, Fluid mechanics lab, Automobile engine test rigs, Computer lab with 120 systems, Central workshop with foundry, welding, carpentry, and fitting sections, Sports ground, Dispensary.
